options.text: $(1, 0)$ is a local minimum and $(-1, 0)$ is a saddle point
$(1, 0)$ is a local maximum and $(-1, 0)$ is a local minimum

questions.question: What does the Envelope theorem guarantee when $V(\theta) = \max_x f(x, \theta)$ is achieved smoothly at $x^*(\theta)$?

options.text: The Hessian with respect to $x$ is zero

questions.explanation: By the chain rule, $V'(\theta) = \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \frac{dx^*}{d\theta} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial \theta}$, and $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 0$ at $x^*(\theta)$.

questions.question: For gradient descent $x \leftarrow x - \eta \nabla f(x)$ on a quadratic whose Hessian has eigenvalues in $(0, L]$, what learning rate range guarantees convergence?
questions.explanation: Each eigenmode scales by $1 - \eta \lambda_i$, which requires $|1 - \eta L| < 1$, i.e., $0 < \eta < 2/L$.
